method: Earned opening-hour simulations using public commands; default deterministic seed, balanced starting attributes, actions every 20 seconds, no resources granted. Existing campaign reviewer policy. This measures openings only, not time to Legacy.

controlledChecks.crewTiming: Copper crew: 135 seconds per load before bonuses; previously 45. Manual loading: 14 seconds.
controlledChecks.recipes: Every equipment recipe consumes double its previous ingots; fuel, purchased supplies and enchantment costs unchanged. Paid historical orders retain original inputs and refunds.
controlledChecks.storage: One free bronze space, three queued batches, one hour away: 3 ingots cast, 1 retained, 2 lost, 2 batches still queued. Using ingots starts the next batch. Concurrent batches account for committed output.
controlledChecks.resume: Unread summaries persist through reload; suspended timers, blur/focus, hidden tabs and existing overlays covered. Dismissed reports do not repeat.
